name: graft-windows
description: Graft code search and caller tracing for Windows x64, with a prebuilt runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Local code navigation without compiler setup.
interface.longDescription: Downloads a versioned runtime with Node and compiled parsers. Indexes the current Git repository locally. No npm installation or model API key required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Map this repository and trace the callers relevant to my change.
